subject: Dependency advisory evidence for the 2026-10-02 audit wave (plans 101-deep-bug-sweep and 102-full-router-audit)
note: This file was committed as {} — a one-line empty JSON object. An empty object is absence of evidence, not an audited zero: no advisory scan output was captured for this wave, and nothing in the repository references one. This record states the gap instead of leaving it implied, and it does not retroactively turn the empty object into a pass.
shape: A reconciliation record, deliberately NOT shaped as a bin/advisory report (apps/api/advisory/report.ts scan fields — version, source, findings, error — are absent here on purpose). It borrows only the advisory tool's outcome vocabulary for status, with the tool's meanings: "clean" — the assessment completed and found no advisory; "finding" — the assessment completed and found at least one advisory; "unavailable" — the assessment did not complete, so the dependency set is unproven.

historical_assessment.why: No wave-era advisory report was captured. This file was the wave's advisory evidence path and was committed as {}; the live assessment tool (bin/advisory) shipped only in 2.43.0 (2026-11-02), after this wave, so no scan in that report's shape could have been recorded. The absence is the fact — nothing here infers that a scan ran and its result was lost.

recovered_findings.what_this_is: The advisory picture the wave's own remediation encodes, reconstructed from artifacts that shipped — not from any wave-era scan output. The nine entries below are the overrides that landed in the root package.json and the advisory each pin closes, matching docs/idea/07-security.md (the overrides section). The pre-remediation advisory inventory behind the 22 of the 2.16.0 claim is not retained anywhere; the advisory flags below the declared range floors were observed against the live database when the gate shipped (CHANGELOG [2.43.0]), not during this wave.
recovered_findings.disposition_rule: Each pin holds its package at or above the advisory's recorded fix version through the package.json overrides block, and the lockfile resolves from there.
